Drew, saw dbt Labs close the Fivetran merger and pick up Google Cloud and Snowflake Partner of the Year for 2026.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Drew, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Post-merger, the combined account map usually grows faster than enterprise headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data-infra sellers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
